exceptions.name: cel
exceptions.reason: Compiling and evaluating the CEL triggers of README.md ("CEL triggers"). k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/cel/environment provides Kubernetes' CEL environment and libraries, so triggers behave like Kubernetes' own CEL features, but declaring the node variable and setting the cost limit need cel-go's API. The standard library has no CEL implementation. Other cel-go packages stay forbidden.
exceptions.approval: Approved by maintainer evrardjp on 2026-11-17; the reference is the review of the change that added this exception to AGENTS.md.

exceptions.name: zap
exceptions.reason: The logging backend that Kubebuilder scaffolds and controller-runtime documents, with its --zap-* flags. A standard-library log/slog backend would work, but keeping the default keeps the generated code standard, which makes long-term maintenance and scaffold upgrades simpler. Direct imports of go.uber.org/zap packages stay forbidden.
exceptions.approval: Approved by maintainer evrardjp on 2026-11-17; the reference is the review of the change that added this exception to AGENTS.md.

exceptions.name: prometheus
exceptions.reason: Defining the kumaco_* metrics of README.md ("Metrics") and registering them on controller-runtime's metrics registry, as Kubebuilder documents. controller-runtime already links this module; the standard library has no Prometheus client, and k8s.io/component-base/metrics wraps the same module for Kubernetes' own registry. Other client_golang packages stay forbidden.
exceptions.approval: Approved by maintainer evrardjp on 2026-11-18, when asked which exception to use for metrics; the reference is the review of the change that adds this exception.
